content_blocks.text: The old mansion loomed ahead, its ivy-covered walls whispering secrets of the past. As the moon cast long shadows across the cobblestone path, Lila approached the front door, her heart pounding. The door creaked open as she pushed it, revealing a grand foyer filled with dusty furniture and faded portraits. She stepped inside, the silence almost palpable. It was here, in this very house, that her grandmother had shared tales of hidden treasures and forgotten loves. Lila's fingers traced the intricate carvings on the banister, each one a reminder of the stories she'd been told since childhood.
